site.title: David Designs Games
site.description: Browser games by David Roman: Order Up!, a free daily cooking puzzle, and Tirada, a roulette roguelite.
site.intro: I design and build browser games you can play in seconds, with no download. Two are live now: a free daily puzzle and a roulette roguelite that is in alpha.

licensing.title: License our games
licensing.intro: Looking for a daily puzzle or a browser game for your website? Both games can be licensed for use on other sites, so your visitors get something new to play without you building it from scratch.
licensing.closing: To talk about licensing, terms or a custom version, get in touch.

footer.name: David Roman
footer.note: Both games run in the browser.

games.name: Order Up!
games.bannerAlt: Order Up! logo with Chef Cara the carrot holding a spoon, and four dish icons
games.hook: A daily cooking puzzle: put the steps in the right order and serve the dish.
games.body: Every day brings a new dish, with a single puzzle that anyone can start from their phone. Chef Cara, the carrot mascot, walks you through each recipe, and the bistro soundtrack keeps the pace light.
points: Mobile-first design, tested on a small iPhone
Hints cost points, so you choose when to use them
Order tickets show each dish's origin and calories
The archive of past puzzles is free for now

suits.title: Order Up! suits
items: Food and drink sites, including restaurant and cafe websites
Grocery, meal kit and kitchen-product brands
Cooking schools and food education sites
Food festivals, food writers and local food guides

games.name: Tirada
games.bannerAlt: Tirada logo: a purple badge with gold lettering and a spinning roulette wheel
games.hook: A roulette roguelite: bet on the wheel, build your run, and beat the house.
games.body: Place your chips, spin, and try to survive the table. Every run is different: pick a character, collect chips and relics, and duel rival gamblers across three floors. The wheel grows as the stakes rise.
points: Three floors with a boss at the end of each
Versus mode lets you go head-to-head against a bot

suits.title: Tirada suits
items: Gaming news, review and community sites
Fan communities for roguelites and deckbuilders

games.name: Old Maw
games.bannerAlt: Old Maw logo over a dark dungeon corridor leading to a glowing chest, with the tagline Take the relic, get out alive
games.hook: A daily dungeon crawler: one lantern, one relic, and one way down.
games.body: Descend into a dark maze with a single lantern. Everyone gets the same dungeon, hero and relic each day, so the whole world plays the same run. Grab the relic, then get back to the ladder before the dungeon collapses.
points: A new maze every day, the same for every player
Grab the relic, then outrun the collapse back to the ladder
One try, no accounts and no rerolls
A harder Gauntlet bonus dungeon every Sunday, with rarer relics

suits.title: Old Maw suits
items: Fantasy, RPG and horror fan sites and communities
Tabletop and D&D blogs, as a daily warm-up game
